description:
Cast Goblin Arsonist by paying {R}.
Goblin Arsonist enters the battlefield, triggering Thornbite Staff, attaching it to Goblin Arsonist.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Goblin Arsonist, adding {R}.
Goblin Arsonist dies, triggering itself, Koll, and Thornbite Staff.
Resolve Goblin Arsonist's trigger, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Resolve Koll's trigger, returning Goblin Arsonist from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve Thornbite Staff's trigger, accomplishing nothing.
Repeat.
